name: 360 Feedback Score
description: Average score from 360-degree feedback assessments.

name: Self-Assessment Completion Rate
description: Percentage of participants completing self-assessments.

name: Pulse Survey eNPS
description: Employee Net Promoter Score from pulse surveys.

name: On-Time Delivery Rate
description: Percent of deliverables completed by the agreed deadline.

name: Absenteeism Rate
description: Average days absent per employee per period.

name: Collaboration Index
description: Composite score reflecting cross-functional collaboration.

name: Manager Feedback Quality
description: Qualitative rating of feedback quality from managers.

name: Time to Productivity
description: Time for new hires to reach target productivity.

name: Error Rate
description: Number of errors per 1,000 transactions.

name: Learning Retention Score
description: Post-training knowledge retention assessment score.

name: Peer Feedback Score
description: Average score from structured peer feedback.

name: Cross-Functional Collaboration Score
description: Score reflecting collaboration quality across teams.

name: Delegation Effectiveness Score
description: Composite score reflecting clarity, autonomy, and follow-through in delegation.

name: Team Satisfaction Index
description: Survey-based team satisfaction score.

name: Coaching Session Completion Rate
description: Percentage of planned coaching sessions completed on schedule.

name: Knowledge Check Pass Rate
description: Pass rate on formative knowledge checks after training.

name: Cycle Time Reduction
description: Percent reduction in average process cycle time post-intervention.

name: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
description: Customer satisfaction score post-interaction.

name: Knowledge Application Rate
description: Percentage of learners applying new skills within 60 days.

name: Mentoring Hours per Employee
description: Average mentoring hours received per employee.
